xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #3305

plan.title: [framework-gap] scope:complete evidence schema conflicts with vBRIEF conformance

narratives.Description: The scope complete acceptance-evidence path previously read bare plan item evidence and disposition fields while the vBRIEF conformance gate rejected those bare keys under issue 1620. Locked Option B uses only namespaced x-directive/evidence and x-directive/disposition. No permanent dual-read and no ITEM_CORE expansion. Cross-gate regression runs under the aggregate quality gate.
narratives.Overview: Unify scope complete acceptance evidence with vBRIEF conformance. Engine reads and writes only namespaced x-directive/evidence and x-directive/disposition. Bare keys are missing or invalid for complete and fail conformance. Cross-gate vitest proves pending namespaced evidence passes both gates under task check. Docs and CHANGELOG updated. Closes issue 3305.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer operator, I want completion evidence to use namespaced x-directive keys that pass conformance, so that I can complete scopes with typed evidence without failing the vBRIEF bare-key gate.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Change acceptance-evidence readers and writers to only use namespaced x-directive keys on plan items.
2. Keep conformance rejecting bare evidence and disposition while accepting x-directive keys via existing prefix rules.
3. Cross-gate regression under vitest and task check.
4. Bare-key negatives plus already-terminal policy tests plus docs migration guidance and CHANGELOG.

items.title: Canonical x-directive evidence and disposition keys

narrative.Acceptance: Given a non-terminal plan item with valid typed evidence at x-directive/evidence, when scope complete runs, then the acceptance-evidence gate accepts it and writers stamp only namespaced keys.

items.title: Bare keys not valid typed evidence

narrative.Acceptance: Given bare item.evidence or disposition, when acceptance-evidence evaluates and conformance runs, then complete treats bare as missing or invalid and conformance rejects bare keys; permanent dual-read is forbidden.
Given a hermetic pending item with valid namespaced evidence, when the aggregate quality gate runs, then both completion evidence path and vbrief-conformance pass in the same regression surface.
Given already-terminal items and human-origin dispositions, when tests run, then intended #3240 policy is explicit and cannot silently bypass suitability or provenance checks.
Given the contract change, when docs and CHANGELOG are read, then happy path uses only namespaced keys and migration from bare or narrative workarounds is documented.

expected_outputs: namespaced evidence passes complete and conformance; bare keys fail
